summary: Dominic Flores and Security Manager Michelle Tan of Silverline Brands escalated a failed quarterly restore drill on their payments database, which stopped at 62% with a checksum mismatch one week before an on-site PCI DSS QSA assessment. David Kim traced the error to a corrupted snapshot chunk that appears related to the April deduplication-layer changes made to address Silverline's still-open backup window case. A restore from an older snapshot taken before the latest dedup patch completed successfully on the call with verified checksums, giving Silverline evidence for the audit. Dominic described this as the third incident in three months and said he will recommend moving backup to another vendor at renewal while keeping Comply. David escalated to P1, committed to an integrity scan of all tenant snapshots since the April patch, and scheduled a follow-up with the Protect lead.
